interpretation_limits: This checks execution and implementation invariants, not learning performance.
Sequential mode uses coordinated training likelihood signals while actor and critic observations remain local.
Cached rollout inputs and post-PPO auxiliary updates intentionally differ from the legacy stochastic-latent training recipe.
Native historical environment binary parity with the manuscript remains unverified.
factor_metric_definition: Final cumulative predecessor likelihood product after all agents per update; ESS=(sum factor)^2/sum(factor^2). No clipping or normalization is applied to training weights.
